purpose: Validate a local renderer for branching representations with explicit comparison, guarded commitment and reversible preview.

activities.label: validate source preservation and phase contracts
render explore compare and commit states locally

queries.expression: do all branches preserve the same source entities relations and unknowns
does the renderer keep exploration and comparison separate from guarded reversible commitment

assumptions: A representation branch can be useful before task purpose is resolved.
The source semantic set is small enough to preserve explicitly in a fixture.
Local browser state is sufficient to demonstrate the interaction contract.
A visual preview can remain representational without mutating an external application.
kill_tests: A branch that drops source semantics must block.
Explore and compare must not acquire execution.
Commit must require confirmation and a reversible preview.
The renderer must remain offline and permission-free.
unknowns: How many alternatives a person can compare before comparison becomes overload.
Whether keeping alternatives visible improves later correction of a choice.
Whether the four projection kinds transfer to real tutorials or coding tasks.
Which explicit user signals should control density, tempo and motion.
How a future agent can supply plans without becoming an opaque authority.
